html:
SMTO-CTX-0007 — Provider tokenizer rejected context

GUID: bf8901eb-5ebb-4c15-9ac3-e9fee15c0ebc
Slug: provider-tokenizer-context-rejected
Domain: CTX · Subsystem: context

What happened

  • Before asking the model, SMTO asks the model server to count how much text this step contains. The server refused to count it, so the model hasn't started answering.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Open Settings › Setup › Model routing and check that the Main model is the one the server actually runs. Ask whoever runs the model server if unsure. If SMTO and the server disagree about the model, the server can refuse to count the text.
  2. In the same place, open Limits and recovery and clear Context ceiling so it says Auto, unless you know the server's real limit. A limit higher than the server allows makes SMTO send more text than the server will count.
  3. Start a new task with a shorter request or fewer attached files. Model settings apply to new tasks, and less text is more likely to be accepted.

What success looks like

  • The new task's steps run and the model replies without this error.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who runs the model server; the details include the server's refusal. Don't raise Output allowance to work around it.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The provider's tokenizer endpoint returned a context-length rejection while SMTO was measuring the request size (provider_tokenizer_context_rejected); no inference request was sent.

What this means

  • The provider tokenizer rejected the attempt to measure this input, with a context-related diagnostic. Inference has not started for this request. A tokenizer/model/template mismatch or an actual capacity excess needs to be distinguished; there is no trustworthy exact token count from the rejected measurement.

Why this can happen

  • The tokenizer measurement response was classified as a context rejection; the underlying capacity or configuration cause remains unconfirmed.

How to diagnose it

  • Check that the tokenizer, model identity and serving template belong together. Compare a small valid measurement request with this rejection before treating a fallback estimate as exact.

How to fix it

  • Verify that the configured model ID, the served tokenizer and the chat template on the endpoint belong together (measure_context in llm/native_tool_client.py), and that context_window_tokens does not exceed the served maximum model length. Then reduce the input or correct the server's context configuration; the rejected measurement gives no reliable token count.
  • Verify the tokenizer, model identity and chat-template pairing. Reduce the input or correct the served model context configuration.

Retry and execution caution

  • Apply the correction and confirm the relevant state before requesting another attempt. Prior completed work remains governed by its receipts.

How to verify the fix

  • The provider accepts context measurement with the intended tokenizer/model pairing; inference preflight then succeeds.

What not to do

  • Do not increase max completion tokens as the primary fix; reserving more output reduces input headroom.
  • Do not claim an inference response occurred when the model request did not start.

Technical notes

  • A tokenizer diagnostic reports context_length_rejected before inference; this is a measurement request, not model generation.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.

Do not confuse with / related errors

  • SMTO-CTX-0001 — The AI model said your request was too long for it
  • SMTO-CTX-0002 — A step's results were too large to send to the model
  • SMTO-CTX-0003 — Your current request is too big for the model
  • SMTO-CTX-0004 — This step needs more room than the model has
  • SMTO-CTX-0005 — Your request and the model's answer won't fit together
  • SMTO-CTX-0006 — Your request is too large for SMTO to plan the task
  • SMTO-CTX-0008 — This task's saved model settings don't match the model
